name: eevee-viewport-self-aov-raytracing
purpose: Verify that an Eevee material can write a color AOV in its surface tree and read that same AOV from its material NPR Tree when ray tracing forces the material into a non-first deferred layer.
passCriteria: A child Blender viewport opens the repro scene with Eevee ray tracing enabled; the selected Suzanne region that is driven by its own material AOV must show a visible checker pattern instead of becoming black, and the normal Eevee render of the same scene must also stay visibly non-black.
